title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 1 in C major

character.text: Galant fughetta in 2/4, derived from the verset

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Alto: the opening of the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 55–82).

sections.label: Subject in D minor (Alto); Answer in A minor (Soprano)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar.

sections.label: Subject in C major (Alto); Answer in G major (Soprano)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 13–20) in part, in the same voices, a fourth lower. Soprano: the opening of the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Alto: the opening of the subject (6 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (7 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (4 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars.
